_source: Ministry of Education / Curriculum Development Centre, Zambia. 'Civic Education Syllabus Grade 10-12' (2013, published by CDC) — Grade 12, Topics 12.1-12.6. Numbering-slip corrections as documented previously (12.1 renumbered from printed 11.3.x; 12.6 from printed 12.7.x; a duplicate 12.5.3 code renumbered sequentially). Sub-topics not separately named in the source for this grade, so each topic is modeled with a single sub-topic bearing the same name, as before. Rebuilt 2026-08-31 to add real term/week/reference data from a second real source, 'MINISTRY OF GENERAL EDUCATION, GRADE TWELVE CIVIC EDUCATION SCHEMES OF WORK' — real, complete for Term 1 and Term 2, blank 'SCHOOL:'/'NAME OF TEACHER:' template fields throughout, nothing to sanitize; this source's Term 3 for Grade 12 was not available, so Term 1/2 placement only is added here, consistent with rule 1 (never fabricate). 12.1 (International Human Rights Instruments) is not shown as distinct Grade 12 term content in this source either — the same content appears as real Grade 11 Term 3 content in this school's practice (see civic_education_grade11.json's new 11.8, which cites 'Teacher's Guide 12'/'Learner's Book 12' for exactly this reason) — left without added week/reference data here, consistent with how 11.1's mirrored cross-grade quirk was handled. A genuinely new topic this file didn't have, 12.5b Environmental Education (environmental degradation, biodiversity, international conventions, environmental management institutions), is real Term 2 content, added here. Each sub-topic's week_number is the real week it was first introduced.

subject.name: Civic Education
subject.description: Senior Secondary Civic Education syllabus, Grade 10-12 (Curriculum Development Centre, 2013).

topics.name: 12.1 International Human Rights Instruments
topics.description: This second source doesn't show it taught as distinct Grade 12 content — see this file's _source note — so no new week/reference data was added; positioned first by original topic order.

competencies.description: Describe the International Bill of Rights (IBR)
Explain the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR)
Describe Treaty Based Human Rights Instruments
Discuss the Specialised Human Rights Instruments
Explain provisions of the African Charter on Human and People's Rights

sub_topics.name: 12.2 Rights of a Child
sub_topics.references: Teacher's Guide 12; Learner's Book 12; Civic Education Syllabus Grade 10-12

competencies.description: Describe Children's Rights
Describe the four principles of the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child (UNCRC)
Discuss the provisions of the UNCRC and the two optional protocols

sub_topics.name: 12.3 Family Law
sub_topics.references: Teacher's Guide 12; Learner's Book 12; Civic Education Syllabus Grade 10-12

competencies.description: Describe family and marriage
Explain the elements of Family Law
Describe types of marriages in Zambia
Assess the effects of separation, divorce and death on the family

sub_topics.name: 12.4 Development Planning
sub_topics.references: Teacher's Guide 12; Learner's Book 12; Civic Education Syllabus Grade 10-12

competencies.description: Explain development planning
Discuss types of development planning
Describe methods of planning
Discuss the importance of budgeting and fiscal discipline in development planning
Explain the functions of micro and macro-economic financial institutions
Examine indicators of development
Outline Zambia's National Development Plans from Independence to present

sub_topics.name: 12.5 Poverty Reduction in Zambia
sub_topics.references: Teacher's Guide 12; Learner's Book 12; Civic Education Syllabus Grade 10-12

competencies.description: Describe poverty
Explain the causes of poverty
Assess the effects of poverty
Discuss poverty alleviation strategies
Evaluate poverty alleviation strategies and their implementation in Zambia

Discuss bilateral and multilateral aid
Discuss international trade
State the role of the World Trade Organisation (WTO)

Discuss the effects of debt crisis on Zambia
Explain Millennium Development Goals (MDGs)
